PRIORITY 1 — REPAIR GITHUB ACTIONS

GitHub has identified the root cause.

Current failure:

Invalid workflow file:
.github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml

Line 1 Column 1

Unexpected value beginning with:

bmFtZTog...

This indicates the workflow YAML has been corrupted or replaced with encoded content.

Execute:

1. Open:
.github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml

2. Restore it to valid YAML.

3. Verify every workflow under:

.github/workflows/

including:

- ivx-ci.yml
- ivx-e2e.yml
- android-emulator-qa.yml
- ios-simulator-qa.yml
- backend-ci.yml

4. Confirm every workflow begins with proper YAML:

name:
on:
jobs:

NOT encoded text.

5. Validate every workflow using GitHub workflow validation.

6. Commit.

7. Push.

8. Re-run every failed workflow.

Return:

- commit SHA
- workflow validation PASS
- all workflow runs
- remaining failures
